headline: Macro favors Capital (Labor Share 93.7, Profits/Wages +7.5%); Equities show 3M pullback in AI hardware (-20.67%) vs. IT/Staffing bounce (-12.04%)

bullets.title: Labor Share Compression
bullets.text: BLS Nonfarm Labor Share stands at 93.73 (-0.67% QoQ, -1.60% YoY), remaining structurally below the 2017=100 baseline.
bullets.reason: Real output growth is accruing to capital owners faster than compensation: nonfarm payrolls sit at 159.3M with average weekly hours capped at 34.4h and hourly earnings at $38.00/hr.

bullets.title: Profits Outpacing Wages
bullets.text: Corporate Profits-to-Wage-Bill ratio hit 0.404 (+7.50% QoQ, +22.00% YoY).
bullets.reason: BEA Corporate Profits expanded to $4,279.9B SAAR (+8.40% QoQ, +26.61% YoY) while the annualized private wage bill grew only +0.47% MoM (+4.30% YoY) to $10,827.8B.

bullets.title: Watchlist Spread Drivers
bullets.text: 3M Watchlist Spread is -8.63pp (Capital Enablers -20.67% vs. Labor-Heavy -12.04%).
bullets.reason: Short-term multiple compression hit AI hardware/power names (SMCI (-39.6%), VRT (-34.6%), NVDA (-26.8%)), while oversold IT outsourcers & staffing rebounded (INFY (+7.8%), CTSH (-0.9%), RHI (-9.8%)). Over 1Y, hardware/grid winners (ANET (+36.8%), PWR (+32.2%), GEV (+24.3%)) still anchor the capex cycle.

bullets.title: AI & Power Capex Catalyst
bullets.text: "Vantage drops plans for Trident data center after Colorado's Aurora City passes moratorium" (Data Center Dynamics).
bullets.reason: Compute & silicon capex expansion shifting income toward capital owners. Also tracked: "US gov’t adds Singapore’s Megaspeed and subsidiaries to export block list" (Data Center Dynamics).

bullets.title: Workforce & Macro Signal
bullets.text: "Allstate silent amid reports of 5,000 job cuts as AI push accelerates" (Crain's Chicago Business) — with U.S. unemployment at 4.1% (2026-10-01).
bullets.reason: Direct headcount reduction / AI substitution compressing labor share.
